name: Lau ca khoai
summary: Lẩu cá khoai is a hotpot of cá khoai, a fish with few bones and crisp, sweet flesh. It comes with herbs and bún.
origin: Cà Mau city and the coast.
taste: Few bones, and crisp, sweet flesh.
howToEat: Share the pot with the bún and herbs.
where: Cà Mau city and the coast.
seoTitle: Lau ca khoai — Ca Mau fish hotpot
seoDescription: Lẩu cá khoai is a Cà Mau hotpot of a fish with few bones and crisp, sweet flesh, served with herbs and bún.
